description: This Java class defines the FreeTextDosingInstructions, a subclass of BaseDosingInstructions, used for handling free text dosing instructions within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for setting, retrieving, and validating instructions, and integrates with the DrugOrder object.

classes.name: FreeTextDosingInstructions
classes.description: Represents free-text dosing instructions, extending BaseDosingInstructions, supporting setting and retrieving instructions and validation.

methods.name: getDosingInstructionsAsString
methods.description: Returns the dosing instructions as a string, ignoring the locale parameter.

methods.name: setDosingInstructions
methods.description: Sets dosing instructions on a DrugOrder object, including setting the dosing type class.

methods.name: getDosingInstructions
methods.description: Retrieves a FreeTextDosingInstructions instance based on a DrugOrder if the dosing types match.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that dosing instructions are not empty for the given DrugOrder.
